title: FLEXI-Haz: Semiparametric Deep Survival Inference Beyond Proportional Hazards
abstract: arXiv:2512.10570v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Flexible survival prediction does not by itself ensure valid inference for covariate effects or subject-specific survival probabilities. We develop FLEXI-Haz, a semiparametric deep neural network model for right-censored data that combines an interpretable linear component in the log-hazard with a flexible function of time and adjustment covariates. This formulation permits nonproportional nuisance effects while retaining interpretable regression parameters. Under regularity conditions, we establish nuisance convergence rates that are minimax optimal up to logarithmic factors over composite Holder classes, together with root-n-consistent, asymptotically normal, and semiparametrically efficient estimation of the regression parameter. For adjustment covariates with finite support, we derive the explicit influence function for cumulative hazard and construct a cross-fitted one-step estimator yielding asymptotically valid pointwise

translated_title: FLEXI-Haz：超越比例风险假设的半参数深度生存推断
translated_abstract: 灵活的生存预测本身并不能保证对协变量效应或个体特异性生存概率进行有效的统计推断。我们提出了 FLEXI-Haz，一种针对右删失数据的半参数深度神经网络模型，它将对数风险中可解释的线性成分与关于时间及调整协变量的灵活函数相结合。这种构造在允许存在非比例的讨厌参数效应的同时，保留了可解释的回归参数。在正则性条件下，我们建立了在复合 Hölder 函数类上直至对数因子意义下达到极小化极大最优的讨厌参数收敛速率，并实现了回归参数的 √n 一致估计、渐近正态性以及半参数有效性。对于取值有限的调整协变量，我们推导了累积风险的显式影响函数，并构造了交叉拟合的一步估计量，该估计量在逐点意义上具有渐近有效性。
tldr: 提出 FLEXI-Haz 半参数深度神经网络模型，在突破比例风险假设限制的同时保留可解释的回归参数，并针对右删失数据实现了极小化极大最优的收敛速率及渐近有效的半参数统计推断。
en_tdlr: FLEXI-Haz is a semiparametric deep neural network for right-censored survival data that moves beyond proportional hazards while retaining interpretable regression parameters, achieving minimax-optimal nuisance convergence rates and asymptotically valid, semiparametrically efficient inference.
